## Question 8
```{r}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# URL for the Miami Swimming and Diving Roster page
url <- "https://miamiredhawks.com/sports/swimming-and-diving/roster"

page <- rvest::read_html(url)

# 1. Grab all person details containers
cards <- page |> 
  rvest::html_elements(".s-person-card")

# 2. Extract names and locations per card
names <- cards |> 
  rvest::html_element("h3") |> 
  rvest::html_text2()

locations <- cards |> 
  rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats") |> 
  rvest::html_text2()

# 3. Build data frame and filter out non-athlete/duplicate rows
swim_df <- dplyr::tibble(
  name = names,
  location = locations
) |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(name) & name != "") |> 
  dplyr::distinct(name, .keep_all = TRUE) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Clean location text to strip out High School or extra details if present
    location = stringr::str_split_i(location, "\n", 1)
  )

# View the result
head(swim_df)
```

## Question 9 
```{r}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# URL for the Miami Swimming and Diving Roster page
url <- "https://miamiredhawks.com/sports/swimming-and-diving/roster"

page <- rvest::read_html(url)

# 1. Grab all person details containers
cards <- page |> 
  rvest::html_elements(".s-person-card")

# 2. Extract names and locations per card
names <- cards |> 
  rvest::html_element("h3") |> 
  rvest::html_text2()

locations <- cards |> 
  rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats") |> 
  rvest::html_text2()

# 3. Build data frame and filter out non-athlete/duplicate rows
swim_df <- dplyr::tibble(
  name = names,
  location = locations
) |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(name) & name != "") |> 
  dplyr::distinct(name, .keep_all = TRUE) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Clean location text to strip out High School or extra details if present
    location = stringr::str_split_i(location, "\n", 1)
  )

# View the result
head(swim_df)
```


## Question 11 
```{r}
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# 1. Read the CSV file containing the toxic IP addresses
ips <- read.csv("toxic_ips_oct2025.csv")

# Ensure we have a vector of IP addresses (assuming the column name is 'ip' or using the first column)
ip_list <- ips[[1]]

# 2. Define the specific fields requested by ip-api.com
fields_query <- "status,continent,country,countryCode,region,regionName,city,district,zip,lat,lon,timezone,currency,isp,org,as,query"

# 3. Query the ip-api.com JSON endpoint for each IP address
ip_data_list <- purrr::map(ip_list, function(ip) {
  url <- paste0("http://ip-api.com/json/", ip, "?fields=", fields_query)
  jsonlite::fromJSON(url)
})

# 4. Bind all rows into a 10-row by 17-column data frame named ip_df
ip_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(ip_data_list)

# View the result
head(ip_df)


## or with For fucntion 

library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Read the CSV file containing the toxic IP addresses
ips <- read.csv("toxic_ips_oct2025.csv")
ip_list <- ips[[1]]

# 2. Define the specific fields requested by ip-api.com
fields_query <- "status,continent,country,countryCode,region,regionName,city,district,zip,lat,lon,timezone,currency,isp,org,as,query"

# 3. Initialize an empty list to hold the API response for each IP
results_list <- list()

# 4. Loop through each IP address by its index
for (i in 1:length(ip_list)) {
  # Construct the API request URL for the current IP
  url <- paste0("http://ip-api.com/json/", ip_list[i], "?fields=", fields_query)
  
  # Fetch JSON and store the converted result at index 'i' in the list
  results_list[[i]] <- jsonlite::fromJSON(url)
}

# 5. Combine the list of 10 individual responses into a single 10x17 data frame
ip_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(results_list)

# Verify dimensions (10 rows, 17 columns)
dim(ip_df)
```
